title: Initialize
description: Host-assigned instance context delivered after negotiation.

config.description: Optional applied configuration snapshot; absent on older hosts/fixtures.

data_dir.description: Plugin-private data directory supplied by the host.

granted_capabilities.description: Capabilities explicitly granted by the host.

ConfigSnapshot.description:
An immutable configuration revision supplied by the host.

Values may contain sensitive data or secret references. Consumers must never
write full snapshots into diagnostics, logs or externally visible errors.

config_version.description: Plugin-defined schema/migration version; independent of package version.

values.description: Configuration object validated by the host before delivery.
